title: HITLOptionContractV1_2
description: Canonical schema enforcing mandatory calibrated confidence, layman clarity, and operational impact statements for interactive HITL options.

display_text.description: The exact fully-formatted user-facing text displayed in the interactive question interface.

label.description: Human-readable label for the option presented to the operator.

plain_english_summary.description: Plain English, jargon-free summary of the option.

impact_statement.description: Operational reality impact statement detailing benefits, risks, and mutations.

evidence_refs.description: Grounding citations or provenance keys backing this option.

recommended.description: Whether this option is marked as recommended.

prior_adjustment.description: Bayesian calibration delta applied from historical ledger feedback.

sample_size.description: Sample count n supporting the Bayesian prior.
